findings.finding: No guidance track record. guidance_track is empty: the saved releases carry no outlook, and the earlier calls' FY2026 guidance (Jan/Apr/Jul 2026) was not retrieved. So the guided-midpoint-vs-actual ratio cannot be checked against ticker-check. The Q3 call says only that the full year 'remains' at the high end of low double digits and that expectations were 'higher in the range compared to earlier in the year'. That is qualitative support, not a measured record.
findings.fix: State next to the result that management's guidance reliability for MA is unmeasured. If repaired, add rows from the Q4 2025 call (2026-01-29) for FY2026 currency-neutral net revenue growth ex acquisitions against 9M 2026 actual 13% currency-neutral (pf_rel_20261029_1, line 81/113), on the same basis, citing the issuer call or its transcript.

findings.finding: All 11 guidance rows cite a Motley Fool copy of the issuer's call (dc_call_20261029) that has syndicated_from null and retrieval search_excerpt (a WebFetch summary). Guidance must cite issuer documents, and a copy must name its original. This review re-fetched the page and the verbatim CFO quotes match every row: FY26 and Q4 net revenue 'high end of low double digits' currency-neutral; FY opex 'low double digits'; Q4 opex 'high end of low double digits'; tax 20-21% for FY and Q4; Q4 OI&E expense about $115m; FX on revenue +1 ppt for FY and -1 ppt for Q4; FX on opex 0.5-1 ppt headwind for FY and 0.5 ppt tailwind for Q4. The values are right; the provenance is incomplete.
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to the issuer's Q3 2026 earnings call of 2026-10-29 (investor.mastercard.com webcast) and keep independent false. Optionally note that the quotes were checked verbatim in review_trace.

findings.finding: The numeric guidance ranges are the lane's reading of words. Management gave no numbers for revenue or opex growth. dc_g_nr_fy26 and dc_g_nr_q4 turn 'high end of low double digits' into 0.12..0.13, and dc_g_opex_fy26 turns 'low double digits' into 0.10..0.13. The 0.12..0.13 reading is reasonable and consistent with 9M currency-neutral growth of 13%, but any driver built on a 12.5% midpoint is an interpretation, not guided numbers.
findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance dc_g_nr_fy26, dc_g_nr_q4, dc_g_opex_fy26, dc_g_opex_q4
findings.fix: Keep the rows, but say next to the result that the revenue and opex guidance is qualitative and that the 12-13% is a reading. Do not present it as a management number in the table or the explanations.

findings.finding: Restricted cash has two scopes. numbers.json nm_restricted_cash_2026q3 = 564 (restricted cash and equivalents only). documents.json dc_f_restr_cash = 2,795, which is 564 plus 2,231 of restricted security deposits held for customers. Both are correct per the Q3 release (lines 213-214). Neither belongs in liquidity.
findings.fix: Use cash 10,147 (dc_f_cash) as spendable cash and exclude the 2,795 in total. Label the 564 as excluding customer deposits.

findings.finding: Competitor numbers for PYPL (revenue Q3 2026 8.6B, growth 2%) and AXP (Q3 revenue 20.06B, billed business 454B, 2026 guidance 10%) come from web-search summaries (search_excerpt) and were not traceable in saved text. Visa's FY2026 numbers were checked against its saved 8-K: revenue 45.9B (operating income 28,110 plus opex 17,793), operating income 28,110, FY2025 margin 0.5998.
findings.where: gather/field.json competitors PYPL, AXP; sources fd_pypl_q3_26, fd_axp_q3_26
findings.fix: Treat the PYPL and AXP quarter figures as context only, not as drivers. If they are used, verify them against each company's own 8-K.

findings.finding: Source fd_upi_sep26 has an approximate date ('date approximate: early October 2026', recorded as 2026-10-01). It is a press copy of NPCI data with syndicated_from null.
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to NPCI monthly UPI statistics and use the page's actual publication date, or keep the source out of drivers and events.

findings.finding: The ERP (pf_erp_implied, 4.2% dated 2026-10-01) was computed against a 5.29% treasury, while the risk-free in use is 4.98% (FRED DGS10, 2026-10-29). The two are not dated as a pair.
findings.fix: Note the date mismatch. The engine's dated-implied-ERP convention applies; no change unless the valuation stage pairs them explicitly.
